acceptance: All 8 TPC-H SF0.01 tables load with row counts equal to dbgen, recorded with engine version and host.
A malformed file is rejected with the column-count error.
Where the check ran, and how to repeat it, is recorded (workflow or command).
description:
#3949 replaced 500-row executemany with native file loading for Firebolt Core and local runs (perf-firebolt-core-bulk-load-20261030, done). Live verification on 2026-11-06 could not run it. Under mocker, Firebolt Core dies with `io_uring_register_buffers failed: Cannot allocate memory` because mocker ignores the memlock ulimit. Under Apple `container`, it ran out of memory at 4 GiB after loading customer and hung for more than 37 minutes at 7 GiB at TPC-H SF0.01. The Databend change in the same PR was broken on every table when verified live (fixed in #3981), so an unverified Firebolt path is a real risk.

Change. Run TPC-H SF0.01 generate+load on Firebolt Core where it can run: a Linux host or CI runner with Docker and memlock, or the docker-integration workflow if it can host it. Check row-count parity with dbgen and the column-count rejection of a malformed file. Fix any defect at its cause.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone; heavy work only through make heavy-run; container checks under mocker one stack at a time (limits in tests/uat docs and the uat-mocker-compose-gaps-20261106 context); no live cloud without owner approval; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment if user-facing.
